description: QA collaboration review between the Common Ground Product Manager and QA Specialist, scoped to how they are working together on the Common Ground project itself.

terms.label: Role & Expectations
terms.description: Each person’s role, responsibilities, ownership areas, and the expectations understood to guide the QA work.

terms.label: Product Knowledge & QA Readiness
terms.description: The Common Ground product knowledge needed for effective QA, and whether it has been developed.

terms.label: QA Quality & Reliability
terms.description: The quality, thoroughness, and reliability of the QA work produced.

terms.label: Ownership & Initiative
terms.description: Ownership taken, initiative shown, and follow-through on QA commitments.

terms.label: Communication & Coordination
terms.description: How the two coordinated, raised issues, and kept each other informed.

responseProfile.stance: Performance consistently falls materially short of expectations.
Performance has meaningful gaps and requires focused improvement.
Performance reliably fulfills the expectations of the role.
Performance significantly and consistently surpasses expectations.

primaryQuestions.question: How well aligned have you and the other person been on the QA Specialist's role, responsibilities, expectations, and the product knowledge needed to perform the role effectively?
answerGuidance: Your understanding of your own role, responsibilities, and areas of ownership on the project
What you understood the other person to be responsible for and expected to own
The priorities, quality standards, expected behaviors, and outcomes you believed should guide QA work
How those expectations were communicated and how clearly you believe they were understood
The level of Common Ground product knowledge you believe is needed for effective QA and whether that knowledge has been developed
Any important differences you believe exist between your understanding and the other person's understanding of the role or expectations

primaryQuestions.question: How effectively have you and the other person worked together to perform the QA function, including work quality, ownership and follow-through, communication and coordination, and what would need to improve?
answerGuidance: The quality, thoroughness, reliability, and effectiveness of QA work completed on the project
How independently QA work moves forward and the amount of direction, follow-up, or oversight typically required
Examples of initiative, ownership, follow-through, issue escalation, or process improvement
How communication between Product and QA has worked, including clarity, responsiveness, understanding, feedback, and follow-through
How QA and Development leadership coordinate on defects, handoffs, priorities, status, fixes, and verification
The changes in expectations, behavior, communication, process, support, or ownership that would have the greatest positive impact
